subject: Portal access handshake - onboard OneTrust + Whistic profiles
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: OneTrust Portal Ops <portal@onetrust.com>, Whistic Support <support@whistic.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Portal access handshake - onboard OneTrust + Whistic profiles

Hi team,

We're kicking off profile provisioning for Redwood Inference and want to streamline access between OneTrust and Whistic so answers and evidence can be synced into both portals with minimal back-and-forth. Can you provision a portal invite and a machine-readable intake for our account? Key asks: 

- Portal invites for both portals to the following contacts: tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com (primary), aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com (security lead), kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com (sales ops)
- Temporary role permissions: ability to upload attachments, answer SIG/CAIQ questionnaires, and request IP whitelist for portal callbacks
- If available, an API token or short-lived link for automated profile sync (we will follow your auth guidance)
- Any vendor-specific required evidence list (SOC 2 report, encryption attestations, data flow diagram) — share a checklist link if you have one

Attaching our latest SOC 2 report and a current network diagram for quick reference. Please let me know expected steps and any delegated roles we should create on our side.

Thanks,
Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Director, GTM Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf, network_diagram_v3.png

From: OneTrust Portal Ops <portal@onetrust.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Portal access handshake - onboard OneTrust + Whistic profiles

Hi Tessa,

Thanks — invite flow looks good. I've created a OneTrust portal request for Redwood Inference and sent an admin invite to tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com. A couple of notes: 

- Portal link: https://portal.onetrust.com/invite/RedwoodInference-portal-6f3c
- We provisioned Admin access to the three addresses you listed. You can change roles under Settings > Team.
- For automated sync: we offer a short-lived API key for vendor integrations; please confirm whether you'll use basic API token or OAuth app. OAuth is required for production sync between OneTrust and Whistic.
- Required attachments: SOC 2 Type II (latest), system architecture diagram (high level), and a CSV of external vendor dependencies if you want us to populate the Vendor Registry.

I've left a few fields blank on your profile (expected sync fields): primary jurisdiction, data residency preference, and a preferred contact phone. If you reply with those we can finish provisioning.

Regards,
Marisol Gutierrez
Onetrust Portal Operations

--
Onetrust note: If you'd like help configuring the OneTrust->Whistic connector we can schedule a 30-min setup call.

From: Whistic Support <support@whistic.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 11:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal access handshake - onboard OneTrust + Whistic profiles

Hi Tessa,

Welcome — we've created a Whistic company profile and sent an invite: https://app.whistic.com/companies/RedwoodInference/onboard-INVITE-9a2b

Next steps we recommend: 
- Accept the invite and complete the basic company details.
- Upload the SOC 2 PDF (we'll store it on your profile).
- Start the SIG Lite questionnaire — you can save progress and assign to collaborators.

We also support a connector to ingest OneTrust questionnaire exports. If you want two-way sync, please request an API integration token in your OneTrust settings (portal team can create).

If you'd like, I can assign a Customer Success (CS) rep to walk through Whistic's evidence mapping. 

Best,
Rohit Sharma
Whistic Customer Success
attachments: none

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Portal access handshake - onboard OneTrust + Whistic profiles

FYI — OneTrust and Whistic both created invites and want a few artifacts. Can you two confirm what we can share as-is and what needs redaction/approval before upload? Quick checklist for security team: 

- SOC 2 Type II (already attached) — redaction policy? We usually remove customer names + IP addresses on the public PDF, but will provide full report for portal upload if OK.
- System/network diagram (attached) — redaction of internal hostnames and exact VLAN segments required?
- Does legal need to sign an NDA before we share raw evidence?
- If we expose an API token for sync, what's the approval flow?

As a reminder, Acme Networks (prospect) is asking for a completed SIG and Whistic profile before the technical review meeting on 2026-06-22. Can we aim to have the profiles reachable by EOD Wed (6/17)?

Thanks — Tessa

--
attachments: onboarding_checklist.xlsx

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Portal access handshake - onboard OneTrust + Whistic profiles

Tessa / Kim — quick answers below: 

- SOC 2: Share the full SOC 2 report with portal vendors under the portals' access controls. For public-facing links we can upload a redacted version. I'll attach the version to the Whistic profile and provide a redacted PDF for marketing if needed. (attachment: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf)
- Network diagram: please remove internal hostnames and exact IP allocations; keep logical tiers and ingress/egress points. I updated network_diagram_v3.png and attached the sanitized copy.
- NDA: Legal says standard vendor portal terms are acceptable for storing compliance artifacts; no additional NDA needed before upload. Escalate to legal only if a vendor requests raw logs or access to internal systems.
- API token: we'll provision a scoped short-lived token via our secrets manager for the OneTrust->Whistic sync. Token creation requires an approval ticket in Jira (SEC-4789).

I'll take the lead on uploads once Tessa confirms the portal invites have been accepted.

Aditya
Senior InfoSec Engineer
Redwood Inference

--
attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf, network_diagram_v3.png
